WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_rate, o.overall_avg
  FROM telescope_averages ta
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse_rate > o.overall_avg
), second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_of_kept
  FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate, fk.overall_avg, sa.avg_of_kept
  FROM first_kept fk
  CROSS JOIN second_avg sa
  WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sa.avg_of_kept
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_average_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - overall_avg) AS mean_above_overall_average,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - avg_of_kept) AS mean_above_second_average
FROM final_kept;
